symbols.name: linear map
symbols.meaning: The linear map whose stretching of vectors the operator norm measures.

symbols.name: test vector
symbols.meaning: A vector whose length matches the input length of the map, over which the supremum is taken.
symbols.quote: The variable $u$ denotes a vector whose length matches the input length of $L$.

relations.quote: The operator norm is defined for any [linear map](linear-map.md), and it is the largest factor by which $L$ stretches a vector.
